### Issue
Cannot simplify x + csch(sinc(1))
    >>> from sympy import *
    >>> x = Symbol('x')
    >>> print(simplify(x + csch(sinc(1))))
    ...
    File "C:\Users\E\Desktop\sympy-master\sympy\simplify\fu.py", line 433, in f
    rv = fmap[rv.func](S.Pi/2 - rv.args[0])
    KeyError: sinc

(I should have said: cannot apply the simplification function, since I'm not expecting any simplification to  actually take place).

+++ b/sympy/functions/elementary/trigonometric.py

parsed.reason: The patch changes the base class of `sinc` from `TrigonometricFunction` to `Function`, which could break existing code that relies on `sinc` being a subclass of `TrigonometricFunction`. This change should be thoroughly tested and documented.
